create.name: Purple Valley Yoga
create.bio:
Purple Valley Yoga is a residential Ashtanga yoga centre in Assagao, a village in north Goa on India's west coast, where Ashtanga in the line of K. Pattabhi Jois has been taught since 2003. It concentrates on that one method and runs one- and two-week retreats led by a rotating roster of senior international teachers, among them John Scott, Laruga Glaser, Ty Landrum, Kia Naddermier and Adam Keen. Retreats are booked through a UK-registered partner, Yoga Journey Ltd, and the centre also hosts groups in Tenerife.

Mornings at the shala, a large tiled-roof hall in the garden, are given to Mysore-style self-practice or led classes, and afternoons to workshops, pranayama, chanting or philosophy, depending on the teacher; some retreats bring in Buddhist meditation and Dharma study. Guests stay on site and share vegetarian meals. The YouTube channel, started in 2013, holds full-length led primary and intermediate classes, series demonstrations, guided meditation and longer conversations with the teachers about practice and life.

courses.title: The Root: Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga and the Path to Wholeness (John Scott)
courses.description: A two-week residential immersion with John Scott built around daily Ashtanga practice, breath and mantra, with an emphasis on personal responsibility in practice and in life. Shorter one-week stays are also offered.

courses.title: Yoga Bhāvanā – The Art of Cultivation (Kia Naddermier)
courses.description: Two weeks with Kia Naddermier joining Mysore-style Ashtanga with classical pranayama, Buddhist meditation and Dharma study, drawing on both yogic and Buddhist lines.

courses.title: Ashtanga Yoga & Self Enquiry (Adam Keen)
courses.description: A two-week retreat with Adam Keen linking a clear, traditional Ashtanga practice to reflection on how yoga shapes the rest of daily life.

courses.title: Black Lotus Practice Intensive (Ty Landrum)
courses.description: A two-week Mysore-style intensive in Ty Landrum's Black Lotus sequences, studying how the system is built and how to practise it with intelligence.

courses.title: Ashtanga Yoga Enrichment for Intermediate and Advanced Students (Laruga Glaser)
courses.description: Two weeks with Laruga Glaser for experienced Ashtanga students, aimed at refining and deepening daily practice rather than pushing further through the series.

flags: Website found via one web search: the domain yogagoa.com was confirmed on Laruga Glaser's own event page (https://larugayoga.com/event/ashtanga-yoga-retreat-with-laruga-glaser-goa-india/), which gives it as Purple Valley's site, and the site itself links this channel.

Retreat centre with pool, massage and beauty services and Ayurveda packages, booked through a UK tour operator (Yoga Journey Ltd); listed as an organisation because its teaching is Ashtanga yoga. Owner may judge it too resort-like.
Base: Assagao is a village in Bardez, North Goa (published address); recorded as 'Assagao, Goa' for mapping.
Email info@yogagoa.com is the centre's bookings inbox; the contact page also has a form.
Retreat prices are the two-week room prices shown on each retreat's booking buttons, in pounds (£); one-week prices also exist.

Teachers file is empty: none of the centre's retreat teachers is on Spiritpedia. Possible future listings: John Scott, Laruga Glaser, Kia Naddermier, Ty Landrum. Kino MacGregor (listed) appears in an older channel video but is not on the current retreat list.
Many of the channel's most-watched videos are asana practice classes; teaching talks and a guided meditation were included alongside.
